products.name: Wireless Headphones
products.description: Enjoy clear and powerful sound with these comfortable wireless headphones. They feature long battery life, noise reduction, and a lightweight design that is perfect for music, movies, and online meetings.

products.name: Smart Watch
products.description: A stylish smart watch designed to help you stay connected and active. It includes fitness tracking, heart rate monitoring, sleep tracking, call notifications, and a long-lasting battery.

products.name: Running Shoes
products.description: Lightweight running shoes made with breathable materials and a comfortable sole. They provide excellent support and are suitable for running, walking, gym workouts, and everyday use.

products.name: Laptop Backpack
products.description: A durable and spacious laptop backpack with multiple compartments for your laptop, books, charger, and other accessories. Its water-resistant material makes it suitable for daily travel.

products.name: Mechanical Keyboard
products.description: A responsive mechanical keyboard designed for programmers and gamers. It features RGB lighting, durable mechanical switches, comfortable keycaps, and a strong build quality.

products.name: Gaming Mouse
products.description: A high-precision gaming mouse with customizable buttons and RGB lighting. Its ergonomic design provides comfortable control during long gaming and working sessions.
